providers.lead_note: Lead note: the agent's PROHIBITED reading is the strict one. Clause 3.1 as quoted allows collecting and storing API data 'for purposes of facilitating your own trading on Kalshi'; research that informs the owner's own trading plausibly falls inside that, research for any other purpose does not, and sharing API data with third parties needs Kalshi's written permission. Two owner questions follow: (1) is every use of archived Kalshi data in these repositories in support of the owner's own trading, and (2) do any PUBLIC repository files or the public dashboard expose raw Kalshi API data (series listings, rules text, quotes) rather than aggregates. Not legal advice; no tier changed.
